subject: general
question: Union Minister of Education launched a free mobile app called ______ , on 5 September 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**EnglishPro**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **EnglishPro App**:​

 
 
• **Union Minister of Education RameshPokhriyal Nishank launched EnglishPro, a free mobile app, developed by the English and Foreign Languages University, Hyderabad.**
 
• The App has been developed by U**niversity Social Responsibility (USR)** is the **first-of-its-kind** initiative by any university in the country and will help learners develop **Indian English Pronunciation in the unique “Indian” way**.
 
• It is an educational resource for **teachers, students, and people from varied backgrounds**.
 
• This app is a good hand-maid to the **“skilling” of youth**.
 
• It tries to achieve the objectives of the interconnected measures by the Government —** Skill India and Digital India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other educational apps by Union Government**:

 
 
• **Diksha App**: It is a national platform for school education, an initiative of the **National Council for Education**, **Research, and Training**. It will help teachers to create** training content, profile, in-class resources, and assessment aids and connect with the teacher community**.
 
• **Vidyanjali App**:
 
The Union Ministry of **Human Resource Development (HRD)** on **16 June 2016** launched the Vidyanjali Mobile App that can be used by anyone to register for** volunteer work at government schools**. Vidyanjali's initiative is in line with the Union HRD Ministry's ongoing efforts under **Padhe Bharat Badhe Bharat.**
